data.one_liner: Provides a stream of device orientation data including rotation matrix, quaternion, and Euler angles.
data.what_it_does: The flutter_rotation_sensor plugin gives real-time access to a device's physical orientation on Android, iOS, and supported web browsers. It provides data in three representations: rotation matrix, quaternion, and Euler angles (azimuth, pitch, roll), with customizable update intervals and reference frames.
use_when: You need real-time tracking of device orientation or movement in space.
Building augmented reality, navigation, or gaming applications requiring compass and rotation data.
avoid_when: Targeting platforms where rotation sensors are not supported.
You only require simple device info without sensor orientation streams.
strengths: Supports multiple formats: rotation matrix, quaternion, and Euler angles.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, and web browsers.
Customizable update intervals and coordinate system remapping.
weaknesses: Web platform may require explicit permission handling via user gestures.
Depends on hardware capabilities and browser Sensor API support.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions required for Android and iOS; web requires runtime permission flows on browsers that enforce them.

alternatives.name: sensors_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need broader access to standard accelerometer, magnetometer, gyroscope, and user acceleration sensors.
